title: release-provenance prints the acknowledge_dangling_provenance input raw inside a workflow-command line
description: LCLI-630 reviewer, info-level (2026-09-28): scripts/release-provenance.mjs:909 (also 942) prints the ACKNOWLEDGE dispatch input inside ::warning::, trimming only its ends. An API dispatch with an interior newline could print forged workflow commands in provenance-pre, a contents: read job. This gains no privilege, since anyone with dispatch rights can already run a modified workflow from a branch, but a log and annotation forgery is a defect.

acceptanceCriteria.text: release-provenance.mjs prints the acknowledge_dangling_provenance input in ::warning:: / ::notice:: lines only after escaping CR, LF and % (or refuses an input containing them), so an API dispatch cannot forge workflow commands; a test covers CR, LF and %0A
bun test and bun run lore check exit 0; reviewer pass

plan: 1. Inventory every site where the --acknowledge value reaches a workflow-command line in scripts/release-provenance.mjs

2. Refuse (exit 2, in parseArgs, before any network call) a value containing a percent sign, CR, LF or any other C0 control/DEL after trimming the ends; render the refused value JSON-escaped, and escape the parse-error error line per the workflow-command data rules so no raw form reaches the log

3. Tests in test/lcli636-acknowledge-escaping.test.ts: interior LF plus a forged error command, CR, literal %0A, and a percent; assert exit 2, no forged command line, escaped rendering; plus a clean-value control
4. Mutation-test refusal and escaping separately; run bun test, typecheck, lint, lint:shell, bun run lore check
implementationNotes: WIP checkpoint (reboot interrupt). DONE: decision is REFUSE, not escape: parseArgs rejects an --acknowledge value containing a percent sign, CR, LF, any other C0 control or DEL (after trimming the ends), exit 2, before any request or annotation. The refusal renders the value JSON-escaped, and the parse-error error line now goes through a new workflowCommandData helper (percent to %25, CR to %0D, LF to %0A), which also covers --launcher-rc echoing its value. Print sites that echo the value: main() running-with-waiver warning and report() waived warning (both now commented as safe only because of the refusal), plus the job-summary WAIVED verdict line (markdown, not a command). Tests added as a new describe block in test/release-provenance.test.ts (LF, CR, literal %0A, bare percent, DEL; two controls; launcher-rc escaping). NOT DONE: the new tests have NOT been run yet; no mutation test; no gates (bun test, typecheck, lint, lint:shell, bun run lore check). NEXT STEP: bun test test/release-provenance.test.ts, fix any failure, then mutate (drop the refusal, then make workflowCommandData identity) and run the full gates.

Resumed at be18fa54, merged origin/dev clean (tracker-only LCLI-621). First test run: 63 pass, 5 fail — all five hostile cases failed on one test expectation, toStartWith missing the 'Error: ' prefix describeError adds to the ::error:: line; fixed the expectation, 68/68 pass. Mutation (a), refusal removed: predicted 5 red (the five hostile tests; controls + launcher-rc green) — actual exactly 5 fail / 63 pass, same five. Mutation (b), workflowCommandData identity: predicted 3 red (literal-%0A and bare-% hostile, whose shownAs asserts %25 escaping, plus launcher-rc) with LF/CR/DEL hostile green because their shownAs comes from renderRefusedValue's JSON escaping, not workflowCommandData — actual exactly 3 fail / 65 pass, same three. Fix restored, file green again.

Reviewer finding 1 closed: added three hostile rows to the LCLI-636 table — interior TAB, ESC (\x1b), vertical TAB (\x0b) — each expecting exit 2, shownAs JSON-escaped (\t, \u001b, \u000b), no forged :: line. Targeted suite: 71 pass / 0 fail. Narrowing mutation of UNSAFE_REFERENCE_CHARACTER to /[%\r\n\x7f]/ reddened exactly the three new rows (68 pass / 3 fail), the five existing hostile rows (LF, CR, %0A, bare %, DEL) and controls staying green — prediction matched actual. Full class restored, suite re-verified 71/71.
Reviewer pass on LCLI-636: APPROVE. Finding 1 (test-breadth gap: TAB, ESC, VT) closed by the rows and narrowing-mutation result recorded above. Parent will check AC1 after this push.
finalSummary: Delivered via opum-ai/lore-cli#377, CI run 36474672803 (all five required dev contexts green on head 7bc40a55). scripts/release-provenance.mjs refuses an --acknowledge value containing %, CR, LF, any other control character, or DEL (exit 2 before any request or annotation) instead of printing it raw inside workflow-command lines; refusal messages show the value JSON-escaped, and workflowCommandData escapes the parse-error ::error:: line and the --launcher-rc echo. AC1: refusal implemented at parseArgs, all print sites inventoried and guarded; hostile tests cover LF (forged :: command), CR, literal %0A, bare %, DEL, TAB, ESC, VT plus two accepted controls; mutations exact (refusal removed 5 red, helper neutralized 3 red). AC2: bun test 4531 pass / 1 skip / 0 fail, typecheck 0, lint 0, lint:shell 0, lore check 0; reviewer opum-workflow:reviewer APPROVE (8be942dc, breadth finding closed at 7bc40a55).
